features.title: Mint green that refreshes your home
features.text: The mint tone brightens your room with a fresh, modern look while the synthetic leather finish wipes clean, keeping your sofa stylish and easy to maintain.

features.title: Adjustable headrests for custom ease
features.text: Lock the headrest at the angle that supports your neck while you watch, read, or nap, giving you freedom to choose comfort that matches the way you relax.

features.title: Pocket-spring seat for lasting comfort
features.text: Pocket springs keep the seat responsive and buoyant, supporting you evenly so your comfort lasts whether you sit for a short break or through a long movie night.

features.title: Ergonomic lumbar support
features.text: Shaped to support your lower back, the sofa encourages healthier posture and helps you ease into relaxation, making even long hours of lounging feel restorative.

features.title: Wide armrests for added rest
features.text: The broad armrests give you space to rest your arms or balance a tray, making the sofa practical and supportive for everyday routines.

name: Pebby 3-Seater Synthetic Leather Sofa With Adjustable Headrest
